title: Anavex Life Sciences to Present at the Citizens Life Sciences Conference
summary: Anavex Life Sciences Corp. (“Anavex” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: AVXL), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing innovative treatments for Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, schizophrenia, neurodevelopmental, neurodegenerative, and rare diseases, including Rett syndrome, and other central nervous system (CNS) disorders, today announced that Christopher U Missling, PhD, President & Chief Executive Officer, will present at the Citizens Life Sciences Conference on Tuesday, March 10th, 2026 at 11:55 AM (ET).
